gizmo.title: Ataata
gizmo.description: Pūrei ataata wātea puta noa i ngā pūtake maha.

configure.title: Taitara
configure.description: Taitara e whakaaturia ana i raro i te ataata.

advanced.title: Ngā ara kuputuhi
advanced.description: Ngā kupu hauraro, ngā whakamāoritanga, ngā whakaahuatanga, me ētahi atu ara kuputuhi mō te ataata.

advanced.title: Wā tīmata
advanced.description: Tīmata te ataata i tētahi wā motuhake (hēkona).

advanced.title: Wā mutunga
advanced.description: Whakamutu te ataata i tētahi wā motuhake (hēkona), me whai wā tīmata.

advanced.title: Whakahohe aratau ako
advanced.description: Ka whakakore i te whakatere whakamua me te whakahoki whakamuri.

advanced.title: Tango i te pātene whakatuwhera ki YouTube
advanced.description: Ka tango i te pātene mō te whakatuwhera i te ataata ki YouTube.

advanced.title: Whakauru he hono tiri?
advanced.description: Ka whakarato i tētahi hono hei tiri i te ataata.

advanced.title: Huna tohuwā
advanced.description: Huna i ngā tohuwā i te tuhinga kōrero.

advanced.title: Huna Tuhinga Kōrero
advanced.description: Huna i te tuhinga kōrero mā te taunoa.

advanced.title: Ara Whakaahuatanga ā-oro
advanced.description: URL ki tētahi ara whakaahuatanga ā-oro (kōnae MP3) e kōrero ana i ngā huānga ataata.

developer.title: Crossorigin
developer.description: Ka tohu mēnā ka whakamahia te CORS.

developer.title: Tukua te pūrei papamuri
developer.description: Kia pūrei tonu ina ngaro te arotahi o te ripa pūtirotiro.

developer.title: Kaupapa āhua pōuri mō te tuhinga kōrero
developer.description: Whakahohe kaupapa āhua pōuri mō te tuhinga kōrero.

developer.title: Whakakore Pāhekoheko
developer.description: Whakakore i te aratau pāhekoheko e taea ai te pāwhiri i te tuhinga kōrero.

developer.title: Tae arotahi
developer.description: (kua whakarērea) Tīpakohia te tae arotahi mō te kaitākaro.
